| Category = Recipes for dessert
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Hazelnut|hazelnuts]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] semisweet or bittersweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]]
* 5 ½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] (125 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) unsalted [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
* ½ tablespoon [[Cookbook:Potato Flour|potato flour]] or [[Cookbook:Rice Flour|rice flour]]  (for those who eat kitniyos)
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], room temperature
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg white]], room temperature
* ½ cup granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] 

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F and [[Cookbook:Roasting|roast]] hazelnuts for about 15 minutes.
# Rub to remove skin and allow nuts to cool.
# Coarsely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chop]] nuts and 2 ounces of chocolate into small chips and set aside.
# Grease a 9x5-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Loaf Pan|loaf pan]] with ½ tablespoon of the margarine and dust lightly with potato flour.
# Place remaining chocolate, broken into small pieces, in top of [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]]. 
# Cover and place over [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmering]] water until melted. 
# Gradually [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] in margarine until smooth and evenly mixed; set aside.
# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] egg yolks, while adding sugar slowly until pale and thick (about 10 minutes). 
# Pour in cooled chocolate, [[Cookbook:Beating|beating]] until thoroughly combined; set aside. 
# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the 5 egg whites at high speed until stiff. 
# With a [[Cookbook:Spatula|rubber spatula]], [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] half the nuts, the chocolate chips and a quarter of the egg whites into the chocolate mixture. 
# Repeat with another quarter of the whites and the remaining nuts. 
# Reverse the process, pouring chocolate over the remaining egg-whites. 
# Gently fold the two mixtures together until uniform throughout. 
# Pour the batter into the pan 
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the center of the oven for about 55 minutes or until a cake tester comes out dry. 
# Allow to cool. Loosen sides with a knife before removing cake.
